scope: description and command-level comparisons; not new causal physics or independent performance samples

metric_definitions.clipped_cycles: legacy request != instantaneous zero-alternative delta; not proof of undelivered residual
metric_definitions.total_target_limited_cycles: post-stage-limit total target != final predicted drive command on enabled cycles
metric_definitions.xy_command_delivery_fraction: instantaneous limiter-delta/request integral ratio; history-dependent, not a physical transmission fraction
metric_definitions.actual_motion: observed path in whole phase including stop tail; not caused displacement inferred from residual
